wins.label: Exceptional revenue acceleration
wins.evidence: Revenue grew 36% year-over-year in Q4, exceeding high end of prior guidance by over 900 basis points

wins.label: Record profitability and cash generation
wins.evidence: Adjusted operating margin expanded to 45%, strongest in company history; adjusted free cash flow margin of 63% in Q4

wins.label: U.S. commercial momentum
wins.evidence: U.S. commercial revenue grew 64% year-over-year; U.S. commercial TCV booked $803 million, 134% year-over-year growth

wins.label: Rule of 40 score doubled
wins.evidence: Rule of 40 score increased to 81 in Q4, a 13-point sequential increase from 68 in Q3

wins.label: Strong customer expansion and retention
wins.evidence: Net dollar retention at 120%, up 200 basis points; customer count grew 43% year-over-year to 711 customers

risks.label: International commercial weakness
risks.evidence: International commercial revenue grew only 3% year-over-year in Q4; Europe described as anemic at 4% growth

risks.label: Strategic commercial contract decline
risks.evidence: Strategic commercial contracts expected to decline from $24 million in Q1 2024 to $4-6 million in Q1 2025

risks.label: Significant expense increase planned
risks.evidence: Expect more significant increase in expense in 2025 as we invest in technical hires and product pipeline

risks.label: Geopolitical and regulatory uncertainty
risks.evidence: Operating in complicated environment with references to competition with China and need for reindustrialization
